directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: Wardoc, help me. I think I'm sick.
entries.JA_current: Wardoc, help me. I think I'm sick.
entries.JA_new: ヴァルドク、助けてくれ。どうも具合が悪い。
咳が出て、めまいもするし、吐き気もある……

entries.EN: I see... Had any contact with rats or zombies as of late?
entries.JA_current: I see... Had any contact with rats or zombies as of late?
entries.JA_new: なるほど……最近、ネズミやゾンビに触れたか？

entries.EN: What do you mean by contact..? I've come across a few, why?
entries.JA_current: What do you mean by contact..? I've come across a few, why?
entries.JA_new: 触れたって……何匹か見かけたけど、それがどうした？

entries.EN: That's right, Marked One. Rats and zombies in the Zone have recently become carriers of a new and poorly understood disease. Scientists have been investigating it, they believe it is the result of a mutation of a simple influenza virus. Locals call it the "Chernobyl plague". As you know, the Zone has an effect on the local flora and fauna, mutating them beyond recognition in some cases. There's no reason why the same thing could not happen to microbial life, like a virus. There's no shortage of rookies around, coming in from beyond the cordon, bringing in sicknesses and infections from the outside. Once inside, the Zone's influence will have an effect on the DNA of these diseases, and this is where we end up! New, unidentified, mutated strains emerging on a regular basis.

entries.JA_new: そういうことだ、マークド・ワン。最近ゾーンのネズミやゾンビが、正体のよく分からない新しい病気を運んでる。科学者たちは調査中で、普通のインフルエンザウイルスが変異したものだと考えてるらしい。地元じゃ「チェルノブイリの疫病」と呼ばれてる。ゾーンが植物や動物に影響して、ときには見分けがつかないほど変異させるのは知ってるだろ。微生物やウイルスに同じことが起きても不思議じゃない。コルドンの外から新入りが病気や感染症を持ち込むことも多い。それがゾーンの影響で病原体のDNAまで変わると、こうなる。正体不明の変異株が次々に現れるんだ。

entries.EN: Wow. How dangerous is this plague?
entries.JA_current: Wow. How dangerous is this plague?
entries.JA_new: うわ……その病気は危険なのか？

entries.EN: So much so that you might die if I don't administer treatment. Hey, don't worry about it. All you need to do is take a course of medication, a special anti-viral solution prepared by the scientists at Yantar. Here, I have a liquid solution that should do it, drink it and you should feel better in no time, it'll go through your system and prevent the virus from reproducing. Don't drink it all at once, try to divide the dosages! And don't forget: try to keep your distance from zombies and rats, in case they're contaminated.

entries.JA_new: 治療しなければ、死ぬかもしれない。だが心配するな。ヤンターの科学者が作った特別な抗ウイルス薬を飲めばいい。ほら、液剤がある。飲めばすぐに楽になるはずだ。体内に回って、ウイルスの増殖を抑える。一度に全部飲むな。何回かに分けて飲め。それと、感染しているかもしれないから、ゾンビやネズミには近づくな。

entries.EN: Thanks a lot, man. Don't you have another bottle by chance? It wouldn't hurt to have extra supply of this medicine on a long hike, you never know what might happen...
entries.JA_current: Thanks a lot, man. Don't you have another bottle by chance? It wouldn't hurt to have extra supply of this medicine on a long hike, you never know what might happen...
entries.JA_new: 助かったよ。もう一本もらえないか？長旅に薬を余分に持ってても困らないだろ。何があるか分からないし……

entries.EN: I'm sorry, but I'm really running short on this stuff - the other stalkers are worried about their lives and health, too. It's hard and time-consuming to make, the scientists don't run a pharmaceutical factory, just a small field lab with limited capability. Your best option is prevention.

entries.JA_new: 悪いが、薬はもうほとんど残ってない。他のストーカーたちも命や健康を心配してる。作るのに手間も時間もかかるんだ。科学者たちは製薬工場を持ってるわけじゃない。小さな野外研究所で、できることも限られてる。予防するのが一番だ。
